family_name: Autex Grid Ceiling Tiles - Frame/Vertex - Square - Uncapped

spec.description:
Autex Grid Ceiling Tiles - Frame/Vertex - Square - Uncapped is a modular 595mm
x 595mm 3D acoustic ceiling tile designed for standard 600mm x 600mm suspended
grid systems. Formed from 100% polyester fibre containing at least 60% recycled
PET, it is available in perimeter coffer Frame or faceted Vertex profiles. The
uncapped design leaves the tile open to the ceiling plenum above, allowing
natural airflow, light diffusion, and targeted acoustic control (NRC 0.15
- 0.35) with Group 1 fire safety.

retrieval.rag_summary:
Autex Grid Ceiling Tiles - Frame/Vertex - Square - Uncapped is a 595mm
x 595mm 3D acoustic tile designed to drop into standard 600mm x 600mm ceiling
grids. Offered in perimeter Frame coffer or faceted Vertex prism profiles, its
uncapped open-top configuration maintains plenum ventilation and lighting
pathways while breaking up sound flutter and reverberation (NRC 0.15 - 0.35).
Made from 100% polyester with at least 60% recycled PET and achieving Group 1

for conventional grid ceilings.
